allOf.description: An array of objects containing the details of each step in the dispatched route. Each object represents a single step.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A key is a unique identifier that is required to authenticate a request to the API.

driver_email.description: Specify the e-mail address of the driver who should receive the route. The e-mail address must be registered in [NextBillion.ai Cloud Console](https://console.nextbillion.ai/).

steps.description: An array of objects to collect the details about the intermediate steps in the route to be dispatched. Each object corresponds to a single step. The array must begin with a start-type step and end with an end-type step, to form a valid route.

type.description: Specify the step type. It can belong to one of the following: `start`, `job` , `pickup`, `delivery`, `end`. A `duration` is mandatory when the step type is either `layover` or a `break`.

arrival.description:
Specify the scheduled arrival time of the driver, as an UNIX timestamp in seconds, at the step. Please note that:

*   Arrival time for each step should be equal to or greater than the previous step.
    
*   Past times can not be provided.
    
*   The time provided is used only for informative display on the driver app and it does not impact or get affected by the route generated.

location.description: Specify the location coordinates where the steps should be performed in `[latitude, longitude]`.

address.description: Specify the postal address for the step.

customer_name.description: Specify the name of the customer for which the step has to be performed.

customer_phone_number.description: Specify the phone number of the person to be contacted when at step location.

instructions.description: Specify custom instructions to be carried out while performing the step.
examples: "instructions": "Customer asked not to ring the doorbell."

meta.description: An object to specify any additional details about the task to be associated with the step in the response. The information provided here will be available on the Driver's app under step details. This attribute can be used to provide context about or instructions to the driver for performing the task

document_template_id.description:
Specify the ID of the document template to be used for collecting proof of completion for the step. If not specified, the document template specified at the route level will be used for the step. Use the [Documents API](https://docs.nextbillion.ai/docs/dispatches/documents-api) to create, read and manage the document templates.

Please note that the document template ID can not be assigned to following step types - `start`, `end`, `break`, `layover`.

duration.description: Specify the duration of the `layover` or `break` type steps, in seconds. Please note it is mandatory when step type is either "layover" or "break".

completion_mode.description:
Specify the mode of completion to be used for the step. Currently, following values are allowed:

*   `manual`: Steps must be marked as completed manually through the Driver App.
    
*   `geofence`: Steps are marked as completed automatically based on the entry conditions and geofence specified.
    
*   `geofence_manual_fallback`: Steps will be marked as completed automatically based on geofence and entry condition configurations but there will also be a provision for manually updating the status in case, geofence detection fails.

type.description: Specify the type of the geofence. Currently, `circle` is the only suppoeted value.

radius.description: Specify the radius of the cicular geofence, in meters. Once specified, the service will create a geofence with task's location as the center of the circle having the given radius. Valid values for `radius` are \[10, 5000\].

geofence_config.description: Specify the configurations of the geofence which will be used to detect presence of the driver and complete the tasks automatically. Please note that this attribute is required when `completion_mode` is either "geofence" or "geofence\_manual\_fallback".

mode.description: Specify the driving mode that the service should use to determine a route

avoid.description: Setting this will ensure the generated route avoids the object(s) specified in the input. Multiple values should be separated by a pipe (|). If `none` is provided along with other values, an error is returned as a valid route is not feasible.

truck_size.description:
Specify the dimensions of a truck, in centimeters (cm), in the format of <height, width, length>. When specified, the dispatched route uses only those roads which allow trucks with specified dimensions.

Please note this parameter is effective only when `mode=truck`. Also, the maximum dimensions that can be specified are as follows:

Height = 1000 cm  
Width = 5000 cm  
Length = 5000 cm

truck_weight.description:
Specify the weight of the truck, including trailers and shipped goods, in kilograms (kg). When specified, the dispatched route uses only those roads which allow trucks with specified weight.

Please note this parameter is effective only when `mode=truck`. Also, the maximum weight that can be specified for a truck is 100,000 kgs.

truck_axle_load.description:
Specify the total load per axle (including the weight of trailers and shipped goods) of the truck, in tonnes. When specified, the dispatched route uses only those roads which can be used by a truck to carry the specified load per axle.

Please note this parameter is effective only when `mode=truck`.

hazmat_type.description:
Specify the type of hazardous material being carried and the dispatch service will avoid roads which are not suitable for the type of goods specified. Multiple values can be separated using a pipe operator `|` .

Please note that this parameter is effective only when `mode=truck`.

routing.description: The `routing` object allows defining the routing characteristics that should be used to generate a route when the Driver uses the in-app navigation. Only `car` mode is supported currently.

distance.description: Specify the total distance, in meters, for an informative display in Driver's app. The distance specified here has no effect on the actual route that the service generates.

document_template_id.description:
Specify the ID of the document template that should be used to collect proof of completion for all steps in the route. In order to complete each route step, the driver will need to submit a form generated by the rules defined in the given document template. Use the [Documents API](https://docs.nextbillion.ai/docs/dispatches/documents-api) to create, read and manage document templates.

Please note that the document template ID assigned to a route does not apply to following step types - `start`, `end`, `break`, `layover`.

ro_request_id.description:
Specify the Route Optimization request ID. When this ID is provided, all other fields will be ignored (including the required fields) and the route optimization result will be used to form the routes and corresponding steps.

Please note that:

*   The driver's email ID must be provided in input `vehicle.metadata` as `user_email` such that the route optimization result must contain a valid driver email, step's arrival time, etc., to make a successful dispatch.
    
*   Document Template for collecting proof of delivery or completion can not be specified when using this field to dispatch a route.
    
*   In case of an error at any part among the routes, the API will immediately return the error with the index of the specific route or route step.
    
*   On a successful dispatch, the API returns the last route, if there are many, in the response payload.

status.description: Returns the status code of the response.

id.description: Returns the unique ID of the dispatched route.

short_id.description: Returns a shorter unique ID of the dispatched route for easier referencing and displaying purposes.

ro_request_id.description: Returns the route optimization request ID which was used to dispatch the route. An empty string is returned if the corresponding input was not provided.

vehicle_id.description: Returns the ID of the vehicle to which the route was dispatched. The vehicle ID returned here is the same as the one used in the route optimization request for the given vehicle. An empty string is returned if the `ro_request_id` was not provided in the input.

distance.description: Returns the total route distance, in meters, for informative display in the driver app. It is the same as the value provided for `distance` field in the input request.

mode.description: Returns the driving mode that is used to build the route when driver starts the in-app turn-by-turn navigation.

avoid.description: Returns the objects and maneuvers that will be avoided in the route that is built when driver starts the in-app turn-by-turn navigation.

truck_weight.description: Returns the truck weight that will determine compliant routes that can be used by the driver during navigation.

truck_size.description: Returns the truck dimensions, in centimeters, used to determine compliant routes that the driver can take when he starts navigating the dispatched route.

truck_axle_load.description: Returns the total load per axle of the truck, in tonnes, used to determine compliant routes that the driver can take when he starts navigating the dispatched route.

hazmat_type.description: Returns the hazardous cargo type that the truck is carrying. The hazardous cargo type is used to determine the compliant routes that the driver can take while navigating the dispatched route.

routing.description:
An object returning the routing characteristics that are used to generate the route and turn-by-turn navigation steps for the dispatched route. The route and navigation steps are available when driver uses the in-app navigation.

Please note the routing characteristics returned here are the same as those configured in the input request. The fields which were not specified in the input will be returned as blanks.

steps.description: An array of objects containing the details of all steps to be performed as part of the dispatched route. Each object represents a single step during the route.

id.description: Returns the unique ID of the step.

short_id.description: Returns a unique short ID of the step for easier referencing and displaying purposes.

type.description: Returns the step type. It can belong to one of the following: `start`, `job` , `pickup`, `delivery`, `break`, `layover` , and `end`. For any given step, it would be the same as that specified in the input request while configuring the step details.

arrival.description:
Returns the scheduled arrival time of the driver at the step as an UNIX timestamp, in seconds precision. It is the same as that specified in the input request while configuring the step details.

The timestamp returned here is only for informative display on the driver's app and it does not impact or get affected by the route generated.

address.description: Returns the postal address where the step is executed. Its value is the same as that specified in the input request when configuring the step details.

location.description: Returns the location coordinates where the step is executed.

customer_phone_number.description: Returns the customer's phone number associated with the step. It can configured in the input request using the `metadata` attribute of the step.

customer_name.description: Returns the customer name associated with the step. It can configured in the input request using the `metadata` attribute of the step.

instructions.description: Returns the custom instructions to carry out while performing the task. These instructions can be provided at the time of configuring the step details in the input request.

meta.description: An object returning custom details about the step that were configured in the input request while configuring the step details. The information returned here will be available for display on the Driver's app under step details.

document_snapshot.description: Returns the details of the document that was used for collecting the proof of completion for the step. In case no document template ID was provided for the given step, then a `null` value is returned. Each object represents a new field in the document.

completed_at.description: Represents the timestamp of the completion in seconds since the Unix epoch. Example: `1738743999`.

parameters.description: A key is a unique identifier that is required to authenticate a request to the API.

type.description: Indicate the type of area to retrieve the road segments it contains. Only a "circle" or a "bbox" can be specified.

lat.description: Latitude of the circle's center location.

lon.description: Longitude of the circle's center location.

center.description: Specify the coordinates of the center of the circular area.

radius.description: Specify the radius of the circle, in meters, of the circular area.

circle.description: An object to collect the details of a circular area. Please note that `circle` attribute is effective only when `type = circle`.

max_lat.description: Specify the maximum latitude of the bounding box area.

max_lon.description: Specify the maximum longitude of the bounding box area.

min_lat.description: Specify the minimum latitude of the bounding box area.

min_lon.description: Specify the minimum longitude of the bounding box area.

bbox.description: An object to collect details of a bounding box's boundaries. Please note that `bbox` attribute is effective only when `type = bbox`.

message.description: Displays indicative error messages in case of a failed request or operation. See the [API Error Codes](#api-error-codes) section below for more information.

segments.description: An array of objects returning the details of individual segments contained within the specified area. Each object represents a single segment.

segment_id.description: Returns the unique ID of the road segment returned.

shape.description: Returns the encoded geometry of the road segment in polyline format.

lat.description: Latitude of the mid-point location.

lon.description: Longitude of the mid-point location.

mid_point.description: Returns the location coordinates of the mid-point of the given road segment.

attributes.description: An object returning attributes associated with the given road segment. Each attribute is represented as a "key : value" pair.

post.description: Assigns available drivers (vehicles) to open orders based on specified criteria and constraints.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A key is a unique identifier that is required to authenticate a request to the API.

orders.description: Collects the details of open orders to be fulfilled. Each object represents one order. All requests must include `orders` as a mandatory input. A maximum of 200 orders is allowed per request.

id.description: Specify a unique ID for the order.

lat.description: Latitude of the pickup location.

lng.description: Longitude of the pickup location.

pickup.description: Specify the location coordinates of the pickup location of the order. This input is mandatory for each order.

dropoffs.description:
Use this parameter to specify the location coordinates of the destination of the trip or the intermediate stops to be completed before it.

Please note

*   The last location provided is treated as the destination of the trip.
    
*   `dropoffs` is mandatory when `dropoff_details` is set to **true**.

lat.description: Latitude of the stop location.

lng.description: Longitude of the stop location.

service_time.description: Specify the service time, in seconds, for the order. Service time is the duration that the driver is likely to wait at the pickup location after arriving. The impact of the service time is realized in the ETA for the "dropoff" type step.

required_all_of_attributes.description: An array of objects to add mandatory requirements for the order. A vehicle must **meet** **all conditions** specified here to be considered for assignment. Each object represents a single condition. Please note that a maximum of 10 conditions can be added here for a given order.

attribute.description: Specify the name of the attribute. The `attribute` is compared to the keys (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

value.description: Specify the desired value of the attribute to be applied for this order. `value` provided here is compared to the values (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

operator.description:
Specify the operator to denote the relation between `attribute` and the `value` specified above. The `attribute` , `operator` and `value` together constitute the condition that a vehicle must meet to be eligible for assignment. Currently, we support following operators currently:

*   Equal to (==)
    
*   Less than (<)
    
*   Less tha equal to (<=)
    
*   Greater than (>)
    
*   Greater than equal to (>=)
    
*   Contains (contains)
    

Please note that when using "contains" operator only one `value` can be specified and the corresponding `attribute` must contain multiple values when defined for a vehicle.

required_any_of_attributes.description: An array of objects to add optional requirements for the order. A vehicle must **meet** **at least one of the conditions** specified here to be considered for assignment. Each object represents a single condition. Please note that a maximum of 10 conditions can be added here for a given order.

attribute.description: Specify the name of the attribute. The `attribute` is compared to the keys (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

value.description: Specify the desired value of the attribute to be applied for this order. `value` provided here is compared to the values (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

operator.description:
Specify the operator to denote the relation between `attribute` and the `value` specified above. The `attribute` , `operator` and `value` together constitute the condition that a vehicle must meet to be eligible for assignment. Currently, we support following operators currently:

*   Equal to (==)
    
*   Less than (<)
    
*   Less tha equal to (<=)
    
*   Greater than (>)
    
*   Greater than equal to (>=)
    
*   Contains (contains)
    

Please note that when using "contains" operator only one `value` can be specified and the corresponding `attribute` must contain multiple values when defined for a vehicle.

exclude_all_of_attributes.description: An array of objects to add exclusion requirements for the order. A vehicle must **not meet any of the conditions** specified here to be considered for assignment. Each object represents a single condition. Please note that a maximum of 10 conditions can be added here for a given order.

attribute.description: Specify the name of the attribute. The `attribute` is compared to the keys (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

value.description: Specify the desired value of the attribute to be applied for this order. `value` provided here is compared to the values (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

operator.description:
Specify the operator to denote the relation between `attribute` and the `value` specified above. The `attribute` , `operator` and `value` together constitute the condition that a vehicle must meet to be eligible for assignment. Currently, we support following operators currently:

*   Equal to (==)
    
*   Less than (<)
    
*   Less tha equal to (<=)
    
*   Greater than (>)
    
*   Greater than equal to (>=)
    
*   Contains (contains)
    

Please note that when using "contains" operator only one `value` can be specified and the corresponding `attribute` must contain multiple values when defined for a vehicle.

vehicle_preferences.description:
Define custom preferences for task assignment based on vehicle's attributes. If multiple criteria are provided, they are evaluated using an AND condition—meaning all specified criteria must be met individually for a vehicle to be considered.

For example, if `required_all_of_attributes`, `required_any_of_attributes`, and `exclude_all_of_attributes` are all provided, an eligible vehicle must satisfy the following to be considered for assignments:

1.  Meet all conditions specified in `required_all_of_attributes`.
    
2.  Meet at least one of the conditions listed in `required_any_of_attributes`.
    
3.  Not meet any conditions mentioned in `exclude_all_of_attributes`.
    

Consequently, a vehicle which does not have any `attributes` defined can't be assigned to an order which has `vehicle_preferences` configured.

priority.description: Specify the priority for this order. A higher value indicates a higher priority. When specified, it will override any priority score deduced from `order_attribute_priority_mappings` for this order. Valid values are \[1, 10\] and default is 0.

attributes.description:
Specify custom attributes for the orders. Each attribute should be created as a `key:value` pair. The **keys** provided can be used in `options.order_attribute_priority_mappings` to assign a custom priority for this order based on its attributes.

The maximum number of key:value pairs that can be specified under `attributes` for a given order, is limited to 30.

vehicles.description: Collects the details of vehicles available to fulfill the orders. Each object represents one vehicle. All requests must include `vehicles` as a mandatory input. A maximum of 100 vehicles is allowed per request.

id.description: Specify a unique ID for the vehicle.

lat.description: Latitude of the vehicle's current location.

lng.description: Longitude of the vehicle's current location.

location.description: Specify the location coordinates where the vehicle is currently located. This input is mandatory for each vehicle.

attributes.description:
Specify custom attributes for the vehicle. Each attribute should be created as a `key:value` pair. These attributes can be used in the `orders.vehicle_preferences` input to refine the search of vehicles for each order.

The maximum number of key:value pairs that can be specified under `attributes` for a given vehicle, is limited to 30.

remaining_waypoints.description:
An array of objects to collect the location coordinates of the stops remaining on an ongoing trip of the vehicle. The service can assign new orders to the vehicle if they are cost-effective. Once a new order is assigned, the vehicle must complete all the steps in the ongoing trip before proceeding to pickup the newly assigned order.

Please note that a maximum of 10 waypoints can be specified for a given vehicle.

lat.description: Specify the latitude of the location.

lng.description: Specify the longitude of the location.

priority.description: Specify the priority for this vehicle. A higher value indicates a higher priority. When specified, it will override any priority score deduced from `vehicle_attribute_priority_mappings` for this vehicle. Valid values are \[1, 10\] and default is 0.

radius.description: Specify a radius, in meters, which will be used to filter out ineligible vehicles for each order. The pickup location of an order will act as the center of the circle when identifying eligible vehicles. Valid values for `radius` are \[1, 10000\].

pickup_eta.description: Specify a duration, in seconds, which will be used to filter out ineligible vehicles for each order. Any vehicle which would take more time than specified here, to reach the pickup location of a given order, will be ruled out for assignment for that particular order. Valid values for `pickup_eta` are \[1, 3600\].

driving_distance.description: Defines a `driving_distance` filter, in meters. If a vehicle needs to drive further than this distance to reach a pickup location, it will not be assigned to that order. Valid range of values for this filter is \[1, 10000\].

filter.description: Specify the filtering criterion for the vehicles with respect to each order's location. `filter` is a mandatory input for all requests.

travel_cost.description: Choose a travel cost that will be used by the service for assigning vehicles efficiently from a set of qualifying ones.

dropoff_details.description: When **true**, the service returns the drop-off steps for each trip and related details in the response. Defaults to **false**.

order_attribute_priority_mappings.description: Collection of rules for assigning custom priority to orders based on their attributes. In case an order satisfies more than one rule, the highest priority score from all the rules satisfied, would be the effective priority score for such an order.

attribute.description: Specify the name of the attribute. The `attribute` is compared to the keys (of each `key:value` pair) in `orders.attributes` during evaluation.

value.description: Specify the desired value of the attribute to be applied for this order. `value` provided here is compared to the values (of each `key:value` pair) in `orders.attributes` during evaluation.

operator.description:
Specify the operator to denote the relation between `attribute` and the `value` specified above. The `attribute` , `operator` and `value` together constitute the condition that an order must meet to assume the specified priority. We support the following operators currently:

*   Equal to (==)
    
*   Less than (<)
    
*   Less tha equal to (<=)
    
*   Greater than (>)
    
*   Greater than equal to (>=)
    
*   Contains (contains)
    

Please note that when using "contains" operator only one `value` can be specified and the corresponding `attribute` must contain multiple values when defined for an order.

priority.description: Specify the priority score that should be assigned when an order qualifies the criteria specified above. A higher value indicates a higher priority. Valid values are \[1,10\].

vehicle_attribute_priority_mappings.description: Collection of rules for assigning custom priority to vehicles based on their attributes. In case a vehicle satisfies more than one rule, the highest priority score from all the rules satisfied, would be the effective priority score for such a vehicle.

attribute.description: Specify the name of the attribute. The `attribute` is compared to the keys (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

value.description: Specify the desired value of the attribute to be applied for this vehicle. `value` provided here is compared to the values (of each `key:value` pair) in `vehicles.attributes` during evaluation.

operator.description:
Specify the operator to denote the relation between `attribute` and the `value` specified above. The `attribute` , `operator` and `value` together constitute the condition that a vehicle must meet to assume the specified priority. We support the following operators currently:

*   Equal to (==)
    
*   Less than (<)
    
*   Less tha equal to (<=)
    
*   Greater than (>)
    
*   Greater than equal to (>=)
    
*   Contains (contains)
    

Please note that when using "contains" operator only one `value` can be specified and the corresponding `attribute` must contain multiple values when defined for a vehicle.

priority.description: Specify the priority score that should be assigned when a vehicle qualifies the criteria specified above. A higher value indicates a higher priority. Valid values are \[1,10\].

alternate_assignments.description:
Specify the maximum number of potential, alternate vehicle assignments to be returned for each order, apart from the vehicle which was assigned as recommended. Please note that:

*   The maximum number of alternate assignments that can be requested are 3.

Each object represents a single condition. Please note that a maximum of 10 conditions can be added here for a given order.

*   Less than (<)
    
*   Less tha equal to (<=)
    
*   Greater than (>)
    
*   Greater than equal to (>=)
    
*   Contains (contains)
    

Please note that when using "contains" operator only one `value` can be specified and the corresponding `attribute` must contain multiple values when defined for a vehicle.

vehicle_preferences.description:
Define custom preferences for task assignment based on vehicle's attributes. If multiple criteria are provided, they are evaluated using an AND condition—meaning all specified criteria must be met individually for a vehicle to be considered.

For example, if `required_all_of_attributes`, `required_any_of_attributes`, and `exclude_all_of_attributes` are all provided, an eligible vehicle must satisfy the following to be considered for assignments:

1.  Meet all conditions specified in `required_all_of_attributes`.
    
2.  Meet at least one of the conditions listed in `required_any_of_attributes`.
    
3.  Not meet any conditions mentioned in `exclude_all_of_attributes`.
    

Consequently, a vehicle which does not have any `attributes` defined can't be assigned to an order which has `vehicle_preferences` configured.

The maximum number of key:value pairs that can be specified under `attributes` for a given order, is limited to 30.

sort_by.description:
Choose a metric for sorting the searched places in the response.

*   `detour_time`: The results are sorted in ascending order of the total driving time needed to reach the POI from the detour starting point on the original route.
    
*   `detour_offset` : The results are sorted in ascending order of the distance between detour point on the route and the start point of the route.

Select the geopolitical view to be applied to the result to handle disputed territories. Following are the allowed values:

*   `Unified` - neutral, global representation
    
*   `AR` - Argentina
    
*   `CN` - China
    
*   `IN` - India
    
*   `PK` - Pakistan
    
*   `MA` - Morocco
    
*   `RU` - Russia
    
*   `RS` - Serbia
    
*   `TW` - Taiwan
    
*   `TR` - Turkiye
    

Please note that:

*   For requests originating from one of the supported regions, the default view is the region itself.  
    Example: Requests from Argentina default to `AR`, from Morocco to `MA`, and so on.
    
*   For requests originating from all other regions, the default view is `Unified`.

A geographic area can be

*   a country (or multiple countries), provided as comma-separated [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country codes

*   a circular area, provided as latitude, longitude, and radius (an integer with meters as unit)
    
    Format: `circle:{latitude},{longitude};r={radius}`
    
*   a bounding box, provided as _west longitude_, _south latitude_, _east longitude_, _north latitude_
    
    Format: `bbox:{west longitude},{south latitude},{east longitude},{north latitude}`

expires_at.description: The date after which the `share_url` expires and the solution becomes inaccessible.

issued_at.description: The date on which the public URL was created.

playground_type.description: The operation or service used to generate the solution which is the same as the playground view used to display the solution.

result.description: An object containing the details of the public URL to view the result.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A key is a unique identifier that is required to authenticate a request to the API.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description:
Specify the bounding box indicating the area to be used for retrieving the incidents from. The bouding box can be specified using a pair of location coordinates - first pair is for the lower-left corner of the bounding box and the second pair for the upper-right corner of the box. Please note that

*   Maximum area of the specified bounding box is 10,000 km2.
    
*   One of `bbox` and `id` is mandatory.
    
*   However, when both `id` and `bbox` are provided, the `bbox` input is ignored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Provide a comma separated list of specific incident's IDs to be retrieved. The maximum number of IDs that can be provided in a list is 5. Users need to provide at least one of `bbox` and `id` for a valid input request. Please note when both `id` and `bbox` are provided in the input request, the `bbox` input is ignored.

**Note:** Incidents IDs can be retrieved from results of previous queries with the 'bbox' parameter.

parameters.name: incident_type
parameters.description: Specify the types of incidents incidents to be included in the response. Multiple values are supported and should be separated by a comma `,`.

parameters.name: incident_validity
parameters.description: Specify the choice of incidents based on their occurrence in time. Multiple values can be separated by a comma `,`.

status.description: A string indicating the state of the response. On normal responses, the value will be `Ok`. Indicative HTTP error codes are returned for different errors. See the [API Errors Codes](https://docs.nextbillion.ai/map-data/traffic-incidents-api#api-error-codes) section below for more information.

msg.description: Displays the error message in case of a failed request or operation. Please note that this parameter is not returned in the response in case of a successful request.

incidents.description: An array of objects containing the details of the all incidents returned for the given input. Each object represents the details of a single incident.

id.description: Returns an unique ID for the traffic incident. Use this ID in the `id` input to retrieve details about specific incidents.

incident_type.description: Returns the type of the incident.

incident_code.description: Returns the code of the incident.

type.description: Type of the geoJSON geometry. Will mostly be one of `Linestring` or `Point` depending on the incident.

coordinates.description: An array of coordinates in the \[longitude, latitude\] format, representing the incident geometry.

geometry.description: An object with geoJSON details of the incident. The contents of this object follow the [geoJSON standard](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946).

description.description: The description of the event.

code.description: The predefined incident code, describing the event.

icon_category.description: The icon category associated with the event. The icon category from the first `events` in the list is also replicated in the `incident_code` field.

events.description: The list of events describing the details of the incident. Traffic incident can be described with more than one `events` object.

start_time.description: Returns the start time of the incident, if available, in the [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

end_time.description: Returns the end time of the incident, if available, in the [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

location_from.description: Returns the name of the location where the traffic incident's impact on traffic flow starts.

location_to.description: Returns the name of the location where the traffic incident's impact on traffic flow ends.

length.description: Returns the length of the road, in meters, affected due to the incident.

delay.description: Returns the delay, in seconds, caused by the incident (except road closures). It represents the additional time required when compared to free-flow travel time with minimal traffic.

criticality.description:
Returns the criticality or the magnitude of delay associated with an incident. The values returned are mapped to following values:

*   `0`: Unknown
    
*   `1`: Minor
    
*   `2`: Moderate
    
*   `3`: Major
    
*   `4`: Undefined (used for road closures and other indefinite delays)

incident_validity.description: Returns if the incident occurrence is ongoing (present) or in the future.

probability.description: Returns the likelihood of the incident occuring. It will be one of: `certain`, `risk_of`, `probable`, `improbable`.

road_numbers.description: Returns an array with the road number(s), if available, affected by the incident.

properties.description: An object containing the details of the incident.

parameters.description: A key is a unique identifier that is required to authenticate a request to the API.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description:
Specifies the region for which the weather polygons are to be fetched. Allowed Values:

*   `europe`: Europe
    
*   `nam`: North America
    
*   `usa`: United States of America
    
*   `australia`: Australia
    
*   `latam`: Latin Americas

features.description: A collection of [geoJSON features](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.3) containing weather condition details for the requested region.

bbox.description: Specifies the bounding box, in format of min\_long, min\_lat, max\_long, max\_lat, containing the weather polygon.

type.description: Type of the geoJSON geometry. Will always be `Polygon`.

coordinates.description: An array of coordinates in the \[longitude, latitude\] format, representing the polygon boundary.

items.description: [longitude, latitude] format location.

geometry.description: An object with geoJSON details of the weather polygon. The contents of this object follow the [geoJSON standard](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.2).

id.description: Specifies the geoJSON feature ID.

area.description: Returns the area of the weather polygon in square kilometers (km²).

category.description: Returns the category of the weather polygon, e.g., "precip". The precipitation type is indicated in `type`.

type.description: Returns the type of the weather polygon. Supported values: `rain`, `snow`, `mixed` and `hail`

children.description: Returns a list of Feature-Ids that represent polygons of the same `category` and `type` with the next higher `level` which lie inside the given polygon. An empty array means no children.

countries.description: The list of countries, represented as [ISO 3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) alpha-3 country codes, that intersect with the weather polygon.

level.description: Returns the level of the weather atom, i.e., a numeric value describing its magnitude. e.g. for the "precip” category, a level of “2.0” indicates the precipitation levels.

parent.description: A single Feature-Id that represents the polygon of the next lower `level` containing this weather polygon. An empty string means no parent.

uniqueId.description: A unique and stable ID of the current weather polygon.

properties.description: An object containing useful details about the weather pattern type, intensity and its impacted area.

type.description: Indicates the type of [geoJSON structure](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.2). Will always be `Feature` .

creationTime.description: Returns the time of the request in UTC as an ISO-8601-compliant date-time string of the form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD

forecastOffset.description: Returns the forecast horizon of the weather polygon, in minutes. Zero represents present time.

rootTimeStamp.description: Returns the time at which the weather polygons were measured/predicted in UTC as an ISO-8601-compliant date-time string of the form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD

timeStamp.description: Returns the time of which the weather polygons refer to (may be in the future) in UTC as an ISO-8601-compliant date-time string of the form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD

properties.description: Contains time related details for the `FeatureCollection` returned.

type.description: Indicates the type of [geoJSON structure](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.3). Will always be `FeatureCollection` .

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Specify the location coordinate of the point (in `lat,lng` format) for which the weather forecast information is to be fetched.

parameters.name: forecastDays
parameters.description: The number of days of forecast data to return, starting from the current day in the station's local time. The accepted range is 1 to 14.

date.description: The forecast date in the station's local timezone, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

maxTemperature.description: The maximum temperature for the day, in degrees.

minTemperature.description: The minimum temperature for the day, in degrees.

moonPhase.description: The moon phase, expressed in degrees (0–360). 0 and 360 indicate a new moon, 90 indicates the first quarter, 180 indicates a full moon, and 270 indicates the last quarter.

moonRise.description: Local moonrise time, formatted as HH:MM:SS.

moonSet.description: Local moonset time, formatted as HH:MM:SS.

precipitation.description: Total precipitation expected during the day, in millimeters (mm), reported with 0.1 mm precision.

precipitationProbability.description: The likelihood of any precipitation during the day, expressed as a percentage (0–100).

sunProbability.description: The likelihood of sunshine during the day, expressed as a percentage (0–100).

sunRise.description: Local sunrise time, formatted as HH:MM:SS.

sunSet.description: Local sunset time, formatted as HH:MM:SS.

thunderProbability.description: The likelihood of thunderstorms during the day, expressed as a percentage (0–100).

uvIndex.description: Peak solar UV exposure index for the day. Higher values indicate stronger UV exposure.

weatherCode.description: A 9-character code describing the prevailing weather condition for the day. Refer to the the [Weather Codes](https://docs.nextbillion.ai/map-data/weather-forecast-api#weather-codes) section for the decoding scheme.

weatherDescription.description: A human-readable description of the weather condition, derived from `weatherCode`. The description is provided in English only.

windDirection.description: The direction the wind is blowing from, expressed as one of: N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE, S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW, VAR (variable), or UNK (unknown).

windSpeed.description: Average wind speed for the day, in meters per second (m/s).

dailyWeatherInfo.description: An array of forecast entries. Each object represents one day of forecast.

lat.description: Latitude of the weather station.

lng.description: Longitude of the weather station.

stationCoordinates.description: The coordinates of the weather station whose data was used to generate the forecast. These may differ slightly from the requested `at` coordinates.

data.description: An object containing the forecast payload.

status.description: For error requests, returns the HTTP error code.

msg.description: For error requests, returns the error message.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A key is a unique identifier that is required to authenticate a request to the API.

type.description:
Select the HOS rule set to be applied. Following rules sets are supported currently:

*   US60H7D: Drivers can be on-duty for 60hrs during any period of 7 consecutive days time.
    
*   US70H8D: Drivers can be on-duty for 70hrs during any period of 8 consecutive days time.

include_cycle_reset.description: Whether to add a cycle reset break (34-hour restart), if needed, while planning stops. Defaults to false.

hos_regulations.description: An object to collect the details of the rules to be applied for HOS compliance.

daily_drive_time_used.description: Mandatory. Duration of driving time, in seconds, accumulated since the last daily, long-break.

daily_duty_time_used.description: Mandatory. Duration of on-duty time (driving + non-driving), in seconds, accumulated since the last daily, long break

time_since_last_break.description:
Duration of continuous driving, in seconds, since the end of the last qualifying short break i.e. any on-duty-not-driving event which was more than 30 minutes. It is considered only when `driver_current_activity.type = driving` and some [more cases listed here](#short-break-qualification-for-a-given-current-driver-state).

If this input is not provided then we assume no short break was taken until the API call was made.

daily_cycle_duty_times.description:
Mandatory. Array of on-duty times, in seconds, for each completed day in the current cycle or since last cycle reset. It should **NOT** include today's duty time.

The maximum array length matches the cycle length as per selected `hos_regulations.type`. It would be 7 if `US60H7D` was selected and 8, if `US70H8D` was selected.

driver_current_hos_state.description: An object to collect the current HOS state of the driver. Providing this input is mandatory for every request.

type.description:
Mandatory. Specify the type of activity driver is undertaking currently. One of the following activities can be chosen from:

*   `driving`: Driver is currently driving.
    
*   `on_duty_not_driving` : Driver is currently on-duty but not driving.
    
*   `off_duty` : Driver is off-duty for a short time.
    
*   `daily_break` : Driver is taking the daily 10hr continuous rest break
    
*   `cycle_break` : Driver is on a 34hr long break to reset cycle times.
    

Please check this section to know the [impact of different statuses on different timers](#current-driver-state-and-its-impact).

time_elapsed.description:
Time elapsed, in seconds, since the start of the current state.

Mandatory for all non-driving statuses: _on\_duty\_not\_driving, short\_break, daily\_break, cycle\_break_.

driver_current_activity.description: An object to collect the details of the current activity of the driver. Providing this input is mandatory for every request.

trip_start_time.description: Planned trip start time. Defaults to current time.

stops.description: An array of objects to collect the ordered sequence of planned stops i.e. all on-duty-not-driving as well as any planned off-duty stops, in the trip. Each object corresponds to one stop.

stop_id.description: Specify an unique identifier for this stop.

stop_type.description:
Specify the type of planned stop. Allows following values:

*   `origin` : Starting location of the trip.
    
*   `destination` : Destination of the trip
    
*   `planned_stop` : A planned on-duty-not-driving stop on the trip.
    

Providing `origin` and `destination` stop types is mandatory.

stop_location.description: Specify the coordinates for the given stop in "latitude, longitude" format.

estimated_stop_duration.description: Specify the estimated time, in seconds, that would be spent at the given stop.

trip.description: An object to collect details of the planned trip and its stops or waypoints. Providing this input is mandatory for every request.

mode.description: Specify the traveling mode to be used for the trip. Defaults to `car`.

truck_size.description:
Specify the dimensions of a truck, in centimeters (cm), in the format of "height,width,length". This parameter is effective only when the `mode`\=`truck`. Maximum dimensions are as follows:  
Height = 1000 cm  
Width = 5000 cm  
Length = 5000 cm

truck_weight.description:
Specify the truck weight inclusive of cargo and trailers, in kgs. Effective only when `mode=truck`

_Maximum value:_ 100,000 kg

hazmat_type.description:
Specify the type of hazardous material being carried and the API will avoid roads which are not suitable for the type of goods specified, to calculate ETAs. Multiple values can be separated using a pipe operator `|` .

Please note that this parameter is effective only when `mode=truck`.

routing.description: An object to collect the routing preferences to be applied for route and ETA calculations for determining HOS compliance.

status.description: Returns the status of the request. In case of errors, the corresponding HTTP error code is returned.

msg.description: Returns the error message in case of errors. This field is not present in the response for successful requests.

warning.description: An array of strings detailing the various warning, if any, returned for the given input request.

trip_stops.description: A array of objects with details of each stop. Each object corresponds to one stop.

type.description:
Indicatest the type of the stop. Possible enums:

_origin:_ Trip’s origin stop

_destination:_ Trip’s destination stop

_planned\_stop:_ A stop that was provided in the input trip plan.

_off\_duty:_ Inserted HOS stop to honor continuous driving regulations.

_daily\_break:_ Inserted HOS stop to honor daily driving or duty limits.

_cycle\_break:_ Inserted HOS stop to reset the cycle duty times rolling-window.

stop_id.description: Returns the unique ID of the stop.

hos_feasible.description: When type is `planned_stop`, this field indicates if the stop is feasible or not feasible under applicable `hos_regulations`.

drive_duration.description: For planned stops, returns the total drive time, in seconds, up to this stop. This is only the trip's driving minutes and doesn’t consider any driver times before the trip.

stop_duration.description: Returns the duration, in seconds, spent at the stop.

arrival_time.description: Returns the arrival time at this stop

departure_time.description: Returns the departure time from this stop.

location.description: Returns the location coordinates of the stop.

available_drive_time_until_break.description: Returns the drive time available until the next short break, in seconds.

available_drive_time.description: Returns the drive time available for the day, in seconds.

available_on_duty_time.description: Returns the on-duty time available for the day, in seconds.

cycle_duty_time_used.description: Returns the cycle times consumed during the current trip, in seconds.

post_trip_hos_state.description: An object returning the status of different timers post the trip.

hos_result.description: An object with details of the HoS compliance status for each planned stop along with stop inserted to comply with HoS.

markers.description: Define marker(s) to be drawn on top of the map. Can be used multiple times.

key.name: key
key.example:
Format: 32 character alphanumeric string

Usage:

key=YOUR_API_KEY

postalcode.description:
Provide the postal code for which the information is needed. At least one of (`postalcode` + `country`) or `at` needs to be provided.

Please note that only 1 postal code can be requested [See this example](#note)

country.description: country containing the postal code or the location. It is mandatory if `postalcode` is provided in the request.[See this example](#note)

at.description:
Location coordinates that you want to get the postal code of. If not providing `postalcode` in the request, `at` becomes mandatory. 

Please note that only 1 point can be requested. [See this example](#note)

lat.description: atitude of the location

lng.description: longitude of the location

places.description: An object that contains details about the place that was provided in the input.

geopoint.description: Refers to the geographic coordinate denoting the center of the postal code in latitude, longitude format.

country.description: Name of the country associated with the geographic coordinate point / postal code provided in the API request

state.description: Name of the state or province associated with the geographic coordinate point / postal code provided in the API request

district.description: Name of the district or region associated with the geographic coordinate point / postal code provided in the API request

subDistrict.description: Name of the sub-district or sub-region associated with the postal code or geographic coordinate point / postal code provided in the API request

postalCode.description: Returns the postal code associated with the requested geographic coordinate point  or the postal code itself as provided in the input API request.

address.description: Returns the address of the postal code provided.

boundary.description: An object containing the boundary details of the postal code area

multiPolygon.description: An array of objects containing  information about all the polygons forming the postal code area. In case, the postal code area is formed by multiple polygons not containing each other, a matching count of `polygon` objects will be returned.

polygon.description: An object containing the details of a single polygon that is a part of the postal code area. In case the postal code area contains other polygon(s), the details of such polygon(s) would be returned through an array of `points` object

points.description: Represents an array of geographic coordinates that define a `polygon` boundary.

lat.description: Latitude of the coordinate

lng.description: Longitude of the coordinate
